entries.subject: Update Composer dependencies
entries.notes: sync a57149e1f6: phpmyadmin/sql-parser 6.0.0 -> 6.0.1 ported to packages/sql-lexer: Context OPERATORS gains -> and ->> (punctuation, flag 16); Formatter adds no space around -> / ->>; IntoKeyword::build escapes INTO columns with Context::escapeAll; AlterOperations no longer treats ASC / DESC of a key part as a statement start; SelectStatement::getTables skips unaliased tables in the alias map; Utils/Query getClause null keyword (our port was already null-safe); CustomJsonSerializer (setAccessible removal) has no TS counterpart. Fixtures regenerated with 6.0.1 (lexer, parser, split, lint, first-statement, format; the new parseAlterTableAddUniqueKey* corpus cases included), sql-gen fixtures re-stamped (no value changes). phpstan/phpstan-phpunit 2.1.1 and vimeo/psalm 6.19.2 are upstream dev tooling: not applicable.

entries.subject: Get export_item param from ServerRequest object

entries.subject: Fix event scheduler toggle in Bootstrap theme
entries.notes: sync 328b8d8003: QA_5_2, merged by 19958e00b0: the Bootstrap theme styles .toggle-container (was .container), and the merge makes events/index.twig mark the switch "on" only for scheduler_state == ON. Our switch (EventsPage.tsx) is on only for schedulerState ON; parity case "the list: scheduler state and its toggle" checks the class on MySQL (ON) and in the MariaDB spot check (OFF). The theme CSS itself: our UI has its own styles.

entries.subject: Disable Events page when event scheduler is disabled
entries.notes: sync 328b8d8003: QA_5_2, merged by 19958e00b0 into Events\IndexController / ExportController: with event_scheduler DISABLED (server started with --event-scheduler=DISABLED, error 1577 otherwise) the list, the editor and the export do nothing and the page shows "The event scheduler is disabled.". Ported: getEventSchedulerStatus returns ON/OFF/DISABLED (EventsListResponse.schedulerState), the list is empty and editor/save/export answer the notice, EventsPage shows only the notice. Golden parity cases run on a MySQL 8.4 started with --event-scheduler=DISABLED and its own reference instance (all events cases pass there), docs/features/05 updated with a checklist item.
